title: DARE TO STAND OUT.

location.series: KMS TEAM / Audi and Audi Sport identity case study

slide_intent: Use a restricted color relationship boldly because recognition can come from the whole field rather than a small accent.
strategic_value: A red-on-dark-red composition can distinguish Audi Sport’s intensity while retaining its signature.
demonstration: Bright red uppercase text fills three lines on a dark red ground, with the red Audi Sport signature below.
practical_value: Compare tonal red contrast with red-on-white or red-on-photograph examples before choosing a background.

content_islands.name: Statement field
content_islands.spec: Place the large uppercase statement across three lines, left aligned.

content_islands.name: Sub-brand signature
content_islands.spec: Position the slanted symbol and Audi Sport wordmark below the statement on the same dark-red field.

reference_purposes.Expression: The entire artwork uses a bright-red statement and signature on a darker red ground.
reference_purposes.Application: The example applies a tonal palette to a typographic Audi Sport campaign panel.

ingredient.name: Audi Sport tonal red field
ingredient.role: Give the sub-brand an intense field of recognition.
ingredient.application: Compare bright-red lettering against the darker red ground; do not infer numeric color values or a mandatory ratio from this example.
ingredient.scope: One historical Audi Sport campaign composition within the KMS case study.
